# Open Source Compliance

## Project license

The repository is released under the MIT License in the root `LICENSE` file. The `license` field
in `moon.mod` is also `MIT`.

## Source and dependency scope

The current implementation is original MoonBit code. It does not port or copy another project's
source, fixtures, images, fonts or test data. The package has no third-party runtime dependency.
MoonBit and Mooncakes names are used only to describe the supported toolchain and package ecosystem.

## Generated files

`pkg.generated.mbti`, `cmd/main/pkg.generated.mbti` and `examples/basic/pkg.generated.mbti` are
generated by the MoonBit toolchain through `moon info`. They are interface metadata for repository
review and are not copied implementation from another project.

## Observed output

Scenario observations are caller-provided run evidence. The project does not bundle external logs,
commercial data, private output, media or credentials. Users integrating a runner must verify that
stdout/stderr and any attached artifact can be redistributed under the chosen project license.

## Competitive references

The public projects listed in `COMPETITIVE_SCAN.md` were read for feature-boundary research only.
No code or fixtures from them are included in this repository.
